theses.subject: Banks
theses.thesis: Banks are the only theme passing the absolute-trend eligibility gate with the highest durability bar (0.79, hurst_tag=trend) and reasonable breadth (0.667), suggesting a genuine trend rather than a one-name spike. However, this is a relative-lean only: the crowding flag (z=1.68) is a size-down caution, not an alpha source, and gate_helps=false means I cannot lean on the one validated edge on this market. I express the lean as a modest relative overweight vs the rest of the board, fully aware the detector is a focus lens, not a return forecast.
evidence: eligible=true with durability_bar=0.79 (only theme passing the trend gate)
hurst_tag=trend with breadth=0.667 (broad, persistent trend rather than narrow spike)
rotation confirms Banks as leader with margin 0.138 over Coal
crowding_z=1.68 flags crowded — a sizing caution, not a fade
theses.dissent: gate_helps=false on this market's history means the trend gate did not reduce drawdown here — the mean-reverting tape whipsaws trend followers, so the eligibility signal has no proven edge in China A-shares. Plus the theme is crowded (z=1.68), historically a concentration top marker in attention-flow, and dir_accuracy 0.337 is below a coin flip.
